newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA cuts variable mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA cuts variable mortgage rates.

text.p: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) said on Wednesday it would cut its variable home loan interest rates by half a percentage point from November 11 for new loans and from December 30 for existing loans.
CBA said it would cut its standard variable mortgage rate to 8.75 percent from 9.25 and would cut its Economiser 'no frills' variable home loan rate to 8.00 percent from 8.50 percent.
The bank said it had also cut its fixed rate home loans by between 10 and 25 basis points. CBA said that its business loan and credit card rates were also under review.

It said the cuts in home loan rates would be accompanied by changes in deposit interest rates, except for the bank's pensioner security account, which pays interest at the government's pensioner deeming rate of seven percent for amounts over A$30,000. It did not specify the cuts in deposit rates.
